page.notes: Printing error: the heading XVIII is printed "XIIX." and is left as printed. Greek passages are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; the marked words (Πολιτικὴ, καὶ, ἐξοχῶ, ἕξεις, and the final Greek phrase) are doubtful. The initial glyph before "Morali" and before "Mediorū" is a decorative sign and was not reproduced. Catchword "Non" and signature "C" are at the foot.
